commit.message:
fix(lsp): preserve dependency aliases in callable references

Resolve external v1alpha5 Tool references by dependency alias and callable ID.

Share the qualified catalog between Hover and Tool completion, reject duplicate alias-qualified declarations, and cover the published MAS ToolCatalog with browser LSP regression tests.

Closes #297.
